Ongoing: Harness conductors breaking at the knee after ~15k flex cycles. This week: Callum proposes routing inboard through the joint axis; Diego says thigh link needs rework.

Ongoing: Spend running ahead of plan; push to stop default expedites. This week: Claire: hardware spend 23% over plan for the quarter, expedites a big share.
Ongoing: Too many life tests for one grip fixture and one dyno. This week: Ingrid says no until DVT; run pinch tests on nights instead.
Ongoing: Whether to machine pelvis plates from 7075 or wait for a casting. This week: Plates released; static load test planned on the drop gantry with a load yoke.
